service.en: Golden Visa for real estate investors
service.ur: رئیل اسٹیٹ سرمایہ کار کے لیے گولڈن ویزا

about: Apply for a 10-year renewable residence permit as an investor who owns property in Dubai.
note: Requirements read from the official Dubai Land Department service page on the checked date. The sign-in forms do not publish their field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Golden Visa for real estate investors. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: Property value of AED 2 million or more, wholly owned by the applicant
A mortgaged property needs a bank letter showing the paid amount
The applicant must be inside the UAE
Spouse, children and parents can be sponsored
documents: E-certificate of title or title deed
UAE ID and current residence permit, if any
fees: AED 9,884.75 in total for the investor's 10-year permit
AED 5,774.50 for each family member's or parent's 10-year permit
AED 318.75 for opening a family sponsorship file
